mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pf.space s WHERE s.id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.type='PERSONAL' AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}) AND (CAST(#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND w.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.state='READY' FOR SHARE OF w)) ELSE false END
SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r62:bindings:' || CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text) || ':' || CAST(#{actor.userId} AS text),0))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability_binding_set(id,space_id,owner_user_id,workspace_id,inherit_personal) VALUES(#{id},#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER}, CASE WHEN CAST(#{workspaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AS uuid) IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.capability_binding_set SET revision=revision+1,inherit_personal=#{inherit} WHERE id=#{setId} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pf.capability_binding_selection WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND binding_set_id=#{setId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.capability_version_status s JOIN pf.capability c ON c.space_id=s.space_id AND c.owner_user_id=s.owner_user_id AND c.id=s.capability_id WHERE s.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND s.capability_id=#{selection.capabilityId} AND s.version_id=#{selection.versionId} AND s.state='PUBLISHED' AND (c.kind='SKILL' OR (c.kind='MCP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.mcp_connector_activation a JOIN pf.mcp_connector_version v ON v.space_id=a.space_id AND v.owner_user_id=a.owner_user_id AND v.capability_id=a.capability_id AND v.version_id=a.enabled_version_id WHERE a.space_id=s.space_id AND a.owner_user_id=s.owner_user_id AND a.capability_id=s.capability_id AND a.enabled_version_id=s.version_id AND (v.auth_kind='NONE' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.connector_credential k WHERE k.space_id=v.space_id AND k.owner_user_id=v.owner_user_id AND k.id=v.credential_id AND k.revision=v.credential_revision AND k.state='ACTIVE'))))) FOR SHARE OF s)
SELECT request_hash,binding_set_id,result_revision,inherit_personal FROM pf.capability_binding_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT capability_id,version_id FROM pf.capability_binding_request_selection WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY capability_id
